_comment: Data/Content/course-index.json - the course map the sidebar and landing page read. Built by `npm run build:content` alongside the day files.

available_days._comment: Days not locked - what a learner can actually open today.

theme._comment: Short description of the week, shown on the landing page outline.

number._comment: Number across the whole course, as the lessons count it: Week 2 starts on Day 6.

id._comment: Optional: the day's own identity, when its front matter sets one. Otherwise its identity is 'd' + number (invariant 10).

revision._comment: Changes whenever anything in the day changes; the studio tags a day whose revision differs from the learner's previous launch. Opaque (invariant 11).
